items.quote: Ye shall offer at your own will a male without blemish, of the beeves, of the sheep, or of the goats.
items.claim: The text says that a burnt offering given for a vow or as a freewill offering must be a male animal without blemish, taken from cattle (beeves), sheep, or goats.
items.actor: offerer (house of Israel or strangers in Israel)
items.object: male animal without blemish of the beeves, sheep, or goats
items.mechanism: divine command passed on through Moses and Aaron

items.quote: Whatsoever he be of the house of Israel, or of the strangers in Israel, that will offer his oblation for all his vows, and for all his freewill offerings, which they will offer unto the LORD for a burnt offering;
items.claim: The rule covers both Israelites and the strangers living in Israel, when they bring burnt offerings for vows or as freewill offerings.
items.actor: house of Israel and strangers in Israel
items.action: offer oblations for vows and freewill offerings
items.mechanism: one standard for offerings, whether the offerer is Israelite or foreign

items.quote: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying, 22:18 Speak unto Aaron, and to his sons, and unto all the children of Israel, and say unto them,
items.claim: The text says the command came from the LORD to Moses, who was told to pass it on to Aaron, Aaron's sons, and all the children of Israel.
items.object: Aaron, his sons, and all the children of Israel
items.mechanism: a chain of instruction from God to Moses to the priests and the people
